messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Struggling to open distance project
parts:
Doogie

I suspect you have not been sent a complete Distance project, hence your inability to open the toucan data.

Ask whomever sent the project to resend; this time using the "Project Export" facility in Distance.   Chapter 4 of the users guide "Distance Projects" explains how projects are organised on your computer.  The section entitled "Exporting, transporting and archiving projects" pertains to your specific situation.

Using the Export facility causes Distance to locate all necessary bits of a project and zip them into a single file.  You (as recipient of this zip file) can open the .zip file in Distance; by using File | Open Project files of type .zip

Distance will open the .zip file and place all necessary project components in their proper location to be able to conduct the analysis
